description: This file defines the 'Link' class which manages relationships between objects in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. It provides methods to construct SQL queries for retrieving related records, add, delete, and check existence of relationships, and manages relationship metadata and join conditions.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: Represents and manages relationships between beans (records) in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM. Supports various relationship types (one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-many), generates SQL queries for related data, handles relationship creation and deletion, and manages relationship metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the relationship link object, retrieves relationship metadata, and sets up related configuration based on field definitions.

methods.name: loadedSuccesfully
methods.description: Checks if the relationship record has been successfully loaded (i.e., relationship exists).

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves related record IDs or data depending on relationship type and role parameter.

methods.name: getRelatedTableName
methods.description: Returns the name of the related table based on relationship direction.

methods.name: getRelatedModuleName
methods.description: Returns the name of the related module based on relationship direction.

methods.name: getRelatedFields
methods.description: Returns the list of relationship fields associated with this link.

methods.name: getRelatedField
methods.description: Returns the specific related field by name.

methods.name: getRelationshipObject
methods.description: Returns the underlying relationship object containing metadata.

methods.name: _get_bean_position
methods.description: Determines whether the current bean is on the left side (lhs) or right side (rhs) of the relationship.

methods.name: _is_self_relationship
methods.description: Checks whether the relationship is self-referential.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Constructs the SQL JOIN clause(s) needed to relate two tables based on their relationship type and parameters.

methods.name: _add_deleted_clause
methods.description: Adds a condition to filter deleted or non-deleted records.

methods.name: _add_optional_where_clause
methods.description: Adds an optional WHERE clause based on additional criteria.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Generates a SELECT SQL query to fetch related record IDs or data, supporting several relationship types and options.

methods.name: getBeans
methods.description: Retrieves related beans (records) as specified by the query.

methods.name: _add_one_to_many_table_based
methods.description: Associates a record in a one-to-many relationship by updating the foreign key.

methods.name: _add_many_to_one_bean_based
methods.description: Associates a bean in a many-to-one relationship by updating its foreign key.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a relationship link between the current bean and other record(s). Supports various relationship types, with logic to handle many-to-many, one-to-one, and one-to-many associations.

methods.name: _add_many_to_many
methods.description: Inserts or updates an association in a many-to-many join table, checking for duplicates.

methods.name: _delete_row
methods.description: Marks a join table record as deleted (sets 'deleted' flag).

methods.name: _update_row
methods.description: Updates a row in a relationship table.

methods.name: _insert_row
methods.description: Inserts a new relationship record into a join table.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes the relationship link between beans, supporting different relationship types and conditions.

methods.name: relationship_exists
methods.description: Checks whether a relationship record exists in a join or relationship table based on key fields, supporting duplicate detection.

methods.name: _get_alternate_key_fields
methods.description: Retrieves the fields that define an alternate key or primary key for duplicate detection.

methods.name: _get_link_table_definition
methods.description: Loads relationship or index metadata for a relationship table from metadata files or cache.

methods.name: _get_link_table_role_field
methods.description: Returns the role column name for a many-to-many relationship, if defined.
